components.name: Selected Voice Row
components.description: Selection remains visible through fill, stroke, checkmark, and aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-voice{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;transition:background-color .18s ease-out,border-color .18s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;width:100%;padding:14px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#20313d);cursor:pointer}.ds-voice:hover{background:#f0f4f8}.ds-voice[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#adbfec;background:var(--accent-soft,#edf2ff)}.ds-mark{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:8px;background:#dbe5ff;color:var(--accent,#2656c9);display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0}.ds-voice svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-info{min-width:0;flex:1}.ds-info strong{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-info small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#62717d);margin-top:3px}.ds-voice>svg{width:16px;color:var(--accent,#2656c9)}.ds-voice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#83a9ff);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-info,.ds-mark,.ds-voice{transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
Mineral-white work surfaces sit beside an ink-navy navigation rail. Cobalt identifies actions and selected voices; quiet borders and compact metadata keep the workspace readable while recordings, transcripts, and output remain the main material.

The implemented character is restrained and operational: familiar browser controls, generous space around the editor, and closely organized rows for voices, materials, and training records. This is a code-derived record of the shipped interface, not an approved image composition. The North Star is a descriptive name for the implemented world, not a separately approved brand claim.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral-white surfaces with an ink-navy navigation anchor.
Cobalt action and selection states, supported by text and borders.
Compact record metadata inside generously spaced work areas.
Native audio controls paired with a waveform derived from actual samples.

rules.name: The Cobalt Selection Rule
rules.body: Use the cobalt family for actionable controls and selected voice states; retain text and structural cues so color is never the only identifier.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and fine borders for ordinary containers; reserve the existing diffuse shadow for the composite studio and floating audio preview.

dos: Do retain a visible focus outline on interactive controls and a keyboard skip link to the workspace.
Do preserve selected voice and output version identity beside their respective controls.
Do move duration and date beneath material transcripts on narrow screens so the audition column stays available.
Do derive waveform marks from real audio samples and use a flat baseline when no samples exist.
Do show capability, error, and job states in words as well as color.
donts: Don't use decorative waveform samples to imply generated audio.
Don't replace real job stages with invented progress or ornamental dashboard metrics.
Don't turn transient notices, disabled controls, or test data into permanent content or visual identity.
Don't extend the current system-stack page heading or literal plus-sign icon into a new display-font or icon rule; these remain implementation exceptions.
